children: Amazon signed a multi‑year, $1B+ deal with Synopsys to use its silicon IP, EDA, simulation and AI engineering tools for Graviton, Trainium, networking, storage and security chips.
Rosenblatt raised AMZN price target to $360 from $335, citing e‑commerce, logistics, cloud strength, data/personalization edge, Alexa shopping tools and steps blocking third‑party AI agents.
Amazon merged Rufus and Alexa+ into Alexa for Shopping. Q2 active users nearly doubled; interactions rose 5x YoY. Sponsored Prompt clicks convert 48% more and yield 21% higher average spend.
TrendForce says Amazon (AMZN) joins Nvidia and Arm as a major server CPU entrant amid rising AI demand, signaling potential shifts in CPU-to-GPU ratios in AI data centers.
A16z warned AI assistants may steer purchases, potentially sidestepping Amazon’s sponsored listings and threatening AMZN’s retail ad revenue tied to its shopping platform.
Goldman Sachs reports Amazon (AMZN) has a $513.9 billion cloud-related backlog, included in a $1.6879 trillion combined backlog for Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet, used to model future revenue.
Amazon signed a 20-year power purchase deal for up to 690 MW from Calvert Cliffs nuclear, including a ~190 MW uprate, tied to $3B+ in plant investments; serves Amazon in the 13-state PJM market
Amazon (AMZN) can largely fund AI capital spending from operating cash flow, implying AI-capex will rely mainly on internal cash rather than external financing amid high yields and a big AI cycle
Amazon (AMZN) said it stopped using nondisclosure agreements with government partners for data‑center projects, changing how it shares project details with local officials during build‑outs.
Lawmakers led by Rep. Jamie Raskin asked Amazon for details on NDAs with officials tied to data-center projects, part of broader congressional scrutiny of data-center transparency and agreement terms
